title: cleome angulata
intro: Cleome angulata, commonly known as Mexican bee plant, is a perennial plant native to Mexico and Central America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include reducing fever, relieving respiratory issues, and treating skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Cleome angulata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
